intro: Zonnit blends sculptural design with inviting comfort. Wrapped in textured bouclé fabric and supported by a swivel base, it brings modern character to living rooms, lounges, and reading corners.

features.title: Modern aesthetic with refined character
features.text: Zonnit features a clean, contemporary silhouette that enhances modern interiors. Its balanced proportions and material contrast create a statement piece that feels both artistic and approachable.

features.title: Fully upholstered comfort in premium bouclé
features.text: Wrapped entirely in textured bouclé fabric, the chair delivers a soft, tactile seating experience. The cohesive upholstery enhances visual warmth while maintaining a plush, inviting finish.

features.title: Ergonomic back support
features.text: The chair’s backrest is thoughtfully shaped to provide consistent ergonomic support. This mindful contouring ensures comfortable seating during extended conversations or quiet reading sessions.

features.title: Smooth swivel base for effortless movement
features.text: The integrated swivel mechanism allows easy rotation without shifting the chair’s position. This flexibility enhances usability, making it ideal for dynamic living spaces.

features.title: Sculptural armrests with warm wooden detail
features.text: Wooden armrests crafted from acacia wood with a mid-walnut stain are mounted on a sleek pipe frame. This curved structure of the chair adds elegance while providing supportive arm placement.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Zonitt Fabric Fully Upholstered Swivel Lounge Chair
